item.title: Princess Road, NW6, 2nd October
item.description:
This is the second time a project funded by Countryside via Brent is fly posting on trees in Princess Road and across the South Kilburn Estate. This is unacceptable and is further blighting an already neglected neighbourhood, and needs to stop. There should be accountability and expectation that those given funds find other ways to promote, seek takers of their projects which does not bring down the area, especially on streets which haven’t even been properly swept since June 2026, including the leaves from these very trees. The organisers should be instructed to remove every single one of them along with the drawing pins from all trees.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Princess Road, London

item.title: Car parked, 2nd October
item.description:
Dear Highways / Traffic Team, I am writing to report a recurring parking problem outside my home at 1 Broadheath Drive, Chislehurst, BR7 6EU, and to request that the existing yellow line restrictions on my side of the road be extended. On the opposite side of the road, the yellow lines have been extended past the houses there, and as a result no one parks in front of their driveways. On my side, however, the yellow lines end just before my property. Vehicles regularly park immediately after the end of the lines, directly in front of my off-street parking area. When this happens, I cannot get my car on or off my property, and on several occasions I have been completely blocked in. These vehicles are also parked very close to the junction, which reduces visibility for drivers turning in and out and for pedestrians crossing. Our road has a number of elderly residents, and the parked cars make it difficult and stressful for them to drive and turn safely into the road. I believe this is a road safety concern as well as an access problem. I would be grateful if the Council could extend the yellow line restrictions on my side of the road to cover the frontage of my property and the approach to the junction, in line with the restrictions already in place opposite. I have attached photographs and security camera footage, with dates and times, showing vehicles parked in this position and blocking my access, as well as a photo showing the extended yellow lines opposite. I would appreciate a reply confirming that this request has been logged and explaining the next steps. Yours faithfully, AshIima Malik 1 Broadheath Drive Chislehurst BR7 6EU

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cow Path, Elmstead, Greater London
